title: Rich-history clean-room and historical row-count differences
population: Recorded clean-room and historical rich-history training and validation materializations.
sample_sizes: Training 15,134 clean-room vs 15,182 historical rows; validation 3,799 vs 3,795.
uncertainty: Not applicable; these are recorded membership counts, not response estimates.
caption_tex: The figure compares public clean-room and historical rich-history materializations by training and validation split. The horizontal axis gives the clean-room minus historical horizon-row count. Training contains 15,134 clean-room rows and 15,182 historical rows, a difference of −48. Validation contains 3,799 clean-room rows and 3,795 historical rows, a difference of +4. These counts describe membership differences in the preserved splits. They are not response effects or uncertainty intervals. Sources: S03 and S04.
